question: What should be done if the sign shows the person is about to leave the body?
premises: If the person is about to depart, the rite can separate him from the life-breaths.
The guru should worship outside that and cast it on the head.
By this Śiva-hand the person clearly becomes a samaya-initiate.
inference: Even in the case of imminent death, the Śiva-hand rite can be applied to confer samaya initiation.
uncertainties: The exact object worshipped outside is not named explicitly.
plain_english: If he is about to depart, the guru should worship outside that and cast upon the head what separates him from the life-breaths; by this Śiva-hand he clearly becomes a samaya-initiate.
